sections.title: Put it together
sections.content: To introduce your family, combine tener, possessives and ser + adjective. Introduce one person at a time and keep the sentences simple.

items.spanish: Tengo dos hermanos. Mi hermano es joven.
items.english: I have two brothers. My brother is young.

items.spanish: Esta es mi madre. Es muy amable.
items.english: This is my mother. She is very kind.

sections.content: You do not need long sentences. Two or three short sentences are enough to introduce your family.
